sentences.en: Willingness to take responsibility is a sign of maturity.
sentences.zh: 承担责任的意愿是成熟的表现。

sentences.en: Age doesn't lead to maturity, unless you're a cheese.
sentences.zh: 年龄并不意味着成熟，除非你是奶酪。

sentences.en: Sami's lack of maturity will lead him to disaster.
sentences.zh: 萨米缺乏成熟会使他陷入困境。

senses.zh: 成熟，成熟期；到期，满期；成熟度，完善；（债券、存款等的）到期日
